Definition: to hide by covering; specifically, to roof (passive participle as noun, a roof) or wainscot; figuratively, to reserve
BiblicalUsage: çâphan means to hide by covering, to roof. It appears 6 times, in 1 Kings among them, and that use is enough to fix its sense.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe çâphan, little-used as it is, earns its place in Scripture.
